== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Was born in Spain.<ref>[https://twitter.com/ROGUE/status/1381214101507018758 Rogue's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Reached Challenger in solo queue for the first time during high school while playing on a laptop with 20 FPS.<ref>[https://youtube.com/clip/Ugz6Tfcmmr6KkUNK5LB4AaABCQ] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* The first pro player he met in solo queue was [[Gilius]].<ref>[https://youtube.com/clip/UgwKVVZD3KzUPz2QYet4AaABCQ] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Was an ADC main in Season 5, playing [[Vayne]] and [[Jinx]].<ref>[https://youtube.com/clip/UgyiVzRmgl_qd14q-5d4AaABCQ] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Nicknamed "'''Senhor Incrível'''" (Mr. Incredible) by [[Vivo Keyd Stars|VKS]] supporters due to his resemblance to the character with the same name from [[wikipedia:en:The Incredibles|The Incredibles]] movie.<ref>[https://x.com/VivoKeyd/status/1916179315277865465 Vivo Keyd Stars' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
** Also nicknamed "Trymbiqueiro" as a pun with his IGN and the word "trambiqueiro" (swindler) by '''VKS''' supporters.
* The first European player to win a title in LEC ([[LEC 2022 Summer Playoffs|2022 Summer]]) and LTA South ([[LTA South 2025 Split 3|2025 Split 3]]).
** Coincidentally, both times were with [[SeeEl]] on the coaching staff.
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x EU 3rd All Pro Team (Winter 2023)
* 1x LTA South 1st All-Pro Team x1 (2025 Split 3)
